records.context: Keep spaCR's GPU work inside the memory a shared card has free.
records.label: spacr._gpu_governor#0
records.source: Keep spaCR's GPU work inside the memory a shared card has free.
records.translation: 让 spaCR 的 GPU 工作保持在共享显卡的空闲内存之内。

records.context: A workstation GPU is often shared by several jobs: a segmentation run, a measurement run and a training processing session can all hold memory on one card. Each of them sizes its batches for an empty card, so whichever allocates last runs out of memory and, before this module, stopped. This module is the one place that decides how much a spaCR GPU call may take:
records.label: spacr._gpu_governor#1
records.source: A workstation GPU is often shared by several jobs: a segmentation run, a measurement run and a training run can all hold memory on one card. Each of them sizes its batches for an empty card, so whichever allocates last runs out of memory and, before this module, stopped. This module is the one place that decides how much a spaCR GPU call may take:
records.translation: 工作站 GPU 常常由多个作业共享：分割运行、测量运行和训练运行可能同时在一块显卡上占用内存。每个作业都按空显卡来确定批大小，因此最后分配内存的那个作业会内存不足，而在有本模块之前它会就此停止。本模块是唯一决定一次 spaCR GPU 调用可以占用多少内存的地方：

records.context: before each batch it reads the free memory of the device and, when the batch is estimated not to fit with ``gpu_memory_margin_gb`` to spare, shrinks the batch or waits for memory to be freed;
records.label: spacr._gpu_governor#2
records.source: before each batch it reads the free memory of the device and, when the batch is estimated not to fit with ``gpu_memory_margin_gb`` to spare, shrinks the batch or waits for memory to be freed;
records.translation: 在每个批之前，它读取设备的空闲内存；当估计该批在保留 ``gpu_memory_margin_gb`` 余量后放不下时，就缩小批或等待内存被释放；

records.context: on an out-of-memory error from PyTorch or CuPy it releases the cached blocks, halves the batch and retries the same item; after a few failed retries at batch size 1 the item executes on the CPU. No item is dropped and the processing session never stops on an out-of-memory error;
records.label: spacr._gpu_governor#3
records.source: on an out-of-memory error from PyTorch or CuPy it releases the cached blocks, halves the batch and retries the same item; after a few failed retries at batch size 1 the item runs on the CPU. No item is dropped and the run never stops on an out-of-memory error;
records.translation: 遇到来自 PyTorch 或 CuPy 的内存不足错误时，它释放缓存块，将批减半并重试同一项；在批大小为 1 时重试数次仍失败后，该项改在 CPU 上运行。不会丢弃任何项，运行也绝不会因内存不足错误而停止；

records.context: after each item it releases the cached memory, so a co-tenant can use it;
records.label: spacr._gpu_governor#4
records.source: after each item it releases the cached memory, so a co-tenant can use it;
records.translation: 每项完成后，它释放缓存的内存，以便共用显卡的其他作业使用；

records.context: after a run of clean items it doubles the batch again, up to the size the caller asked for;
records.label: spacr._gpu_governor#5
records.source: after a run of clean items it doubles the batch again, up to the size the caller asked for;
records.translation: 连续多项顺利完成后，它再次将批加倍，直至调用方请求的大小；

records.context: ``gpu_memory_fraction`` sets a hard ceiling through ``torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction``. That call caps the memory PyTorch's caching allocator RESERVES, which is more than it has allocated by the allocator's fragmentation, so every need and cap here is sized from ``torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved`` and never below 1.5 times the allocated peak; a ceiling set lower than what the work needs is raised, with a message, rather than turning every larger item into an out-of-memory retry;
records.label: spacr._gpu_governor#6
records.source: ``gpu_memory_fraction`` sets a hard ceiling through ``torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction``. That call caps the memory PyTorch's caching allocator RESERVES, which is more than it has allocated by the allocator's fragmentation, so every need and cap here is sized from ``torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved`` and never below 1.5 times the allocated peak; a ceiling set lower than what the work needs is raised, with a message, rather than turning every larger item into an out-of-memory retry;
records.translation: ``gpu_memory_fraction`` 通过 ``torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction`` 设置硬上限。该调用限制的是 PyTorch 缓存分配器所 RESERVES（预留）的内存，由于分配器的碎片化，这比已分配的内存更多，因此这里的每项需求和上限都依据 ``torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved`` 计算，且绝不低于已分配峰值的 1.5 倍；设置得低于工作所需的上限会被提高并给出消息，而不是让每个较大的项都变成内存不足重试；

records.context: when CUDA has not been initialised yet and ``PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF`` is unset, :func:`_configure` sets it to ``expandable_segments:True``, which lets the allocator grow segments in place instead of reserving new ones, so reserved memory stays close to allocated memory. An existing value is never changed, and a process that already holds a CUDA context keeps the allocator it has;
records.label: spacr._gpu_governor#7
records.source: when CUDA has not been initialised yet and ``PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF`` is unset, :func:`_configure` sets it to ``expandable_segments:True``, which lets the allocator grow segments in place instead of reserving new ones, so reserved memory stays close to allocated memory. An existing value is never changed, and a process that already holds a CUDA context keeps the allocator it has;
records.translation: 当 CUDA 尚未初始化且 ``PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF`` 未设置时，:func:`_configure` 将其设为 ``expandable_segments:True``，使分配器就地扩展段而不是预留新段，从而让预留内存接近已分配内存。已有的值绝不会被更改，已持有 CUDA 上下文的进程保留其现有的分配器；

records.context: every process is counted with about 0.4 GB of CUDA context on top of what its allocator reserves, in the ledger and in the budget;
records.label: spacr._gpu_governor#8
records.source: every process is counted with about 0.4 GB of CUDA context on top of what its allocator reserves, in the ledger and in the budget;
records.translation: 在账本和预算中，每个进程除其分配器预留的内存外，还按约 0.4 GB 的 CUDA 上下文计算；

records.context: a ledger file under the user cache directory records what every spaCR GPU process on the machine is using and about to claim, so a new job counts what the others are about to take and an executing job shrinks while room is needed. Entries of processes that no longer exist are ignored;
records.label: spacr._gpu_governor#9
records.source: a ledger file under the user cache directory records what every spaCR GPU process on the machine is using and about to claim, so a new job counts what the others are about to take and a running job shrinks while room is needed. Entries of processes that no longer exist are ignored;
records.translation: 用户缓存目录下的一个账本文件记录机器上每个 spaCR GPU 进程正在使用和即将申请的内存，因此新作业会把其他作业即将占用的内存计算在内，而正在运行的作业在需要腾出空间时会缩小。已不存在的进程的条目会被忽略；

records.context: while a site is adapting, a line such as ``[gpu] site=measure_intensity items=200 shrinks=0 oom_retries=6 cpu_fallbacks=2 (1.0%)`` is printed every 50 items or 60 seconds, and a warning when more than 3 % of a site's items ran on the CPU;
records.label: spacr._gpu_governor#10
records.source: while a site is adapting, a line such as ``[gpu] site=measure_intensity items=200 shrinks=0 oom_retries=6 cpu_fallbacks=2 (1.0%)`` is printed every 50 items or 60 seconds, and a warning when more than 3 % of a site's items ran on the CPU;
records.translation: 当某个调用点正在自适应调整时，每 50 项或每 60 秒打印一行，例如 ``[gpu] site=measure_intensity items=200 shrinks=0 oom_retries=6 cpu_fallbacks=2 (1.0%)``；当某个调用点超过 3 % 的项在 CPU 上运行时，会给出警告；

records.context: every item's compute path (``gpu`` or ``cpu``) is recorded. Measure writes it as a ``compute_path`` column on its object rows when ``measure_gpu`` is on, and the run report says whether the run stayed on one path. ``gpu_fallback_policy='pause'`` never falls back: an item that does not fit even at batch size 1 waits for the GPU instead, so a run stays on one path;
records.label: spacr._gpu_governor#11
records.source: every item's compute path (``gpu`` or ``cpu``) is recorded. Measure writes it as a ``compute_path`` column on its object rows when ``measure_gpu`` is on, and the run report says whether the run stayed on one path. ``gpu_fallback_policy='pause'`` never falls back: an item that does not fit even at batch size 1 waits for the GPU instead, so a run stays on one path;
records.translation: 每项的计算路径（``gpu`` 或 ``cpu``）都会被记录。Measure 会将其作为 ``compute_path`` 列写入对象行（在 ``measure_gpu`` 开启时），运行报告会说明运行是否始终在同一路径上。``gpu_fallback_policy='pause'`` 从不回退：即使在批大小为 1 时也放不下的项会改为等待 GPU，从而使运行保持在同一路径上；

records.context: the shrink, wait, retry, fallback and ramp-up counts are summarised in the run log at the end of a run.
records.label: spacr._gpu_governor#12
records.source: the shrink, wait, retry, fallback and ramp-up counts are summarised in the run log at the end of a run.
records.translation: 缩小、等待、重试、回退和回升的次数会在运行结束时汇总到运行日志中。

records.context: ``gpu_adaptive_batch=False`` turns the batch control off: every call then runs exactly as asked, with only the optional fraction applied. On a machine without a visible CUDA device every call also runs exactly as asked.
records.label: spacr._gpu_governor#13
records.source: ``gpu_adaptive_batch=False`` turns the batch control off: every call then runs exactly as asked, with only the optional fraction applied. On a machine without a visible CUDA device every call also runs exactly as asked.
records.translation: ``gpu_adaptive_batch=False`` 关闭批控制：此时每次调用都完全按请求运行，只施加可选的内存比例。在没有可见 CUDA 设备的机器上，每次调用也完全按请求运行。

records.context: **Layout engine** (:class:`ReportItem`, :class:`ReportBlock`, :func:`paginate`, :func:`render_report`). A report is a list of blocks, each a heading plus panel items. An item is half or full page width with a height in mm. Items are packed into rows (two half items, or one full item), rows into A4 portrait pages (210 x 297 mm). A block that does not fit the rest of a page starts on a new page; a block taller than a page flows on, row by row, with its heading repeated. Text sizes are fixed in points (never below 5 pt), so a long report gets more pages, never smaller text. Panels whose condition axis does not fit the page width are split into chunks of conditions (:func:`condition_chunks`) drawn as consecutive rows.

records.context: This module is also the authority on **what an extracted-image-region PNG on disk means** -- see the "Crop PNG format" section below. In short: the current format is 3 ("declared_rgb", :data:`CROP_FORMAT_CURRENT`), whose red, green and blue slots hold exactly the source image data channels ``settings['png_channel_mapping']`` names; format 1 ("legacy", unmarked) holds the same bytes for the default mapping and is returned untouched; format 2, written for eleven days in 2026, is the one that is reversed, and :func:`read_crop_png` is what reverses it back. A folder says which format it is via a ``.spacr_crop_format.json`` sidecar, and an unmarked folder is format 1.

A folder says which format it is via a ``.spacr_crop_format.json`` sidecar, and an unmarked folder is format 1.
records.translation: 本模块也是判定 **磁盘上的裁剪图 PNG 含义** 的权威——参见下文的 "Crop PNG format" 一节。简而言之：当前格式为 3（"declared_rgb"，:data:`CROP_FORMAT_CURRENT`），其红、绿、蓝槽位恰好存放 ``settings['png_channel_mapping']`` 所指定的源通道；格式 1（"legacy"，无标记）在默认映射下存放相同的字节，原样返回；格式 2 在 2026 年写入了十一天，是通道顺序被颠倒的格式，:func:`read_crop_png` 负责将其还原。文件夹通过 ``.spacr_crop_format.json`` 附属文件说明其格式，无标记的文件夹为格式 1。
